summaries.plain:
Earlier work completed core cleanup, observability, pagination, dependency typing, structured errors, request-ID health logging, DST-safe scheduler recurrence, and verified timezone/runtime behavior. The latest full suite passed with 184 tests passed and 2 skipped. Work is on `release/2026.18`.

Currency rounding was validated with new tests in `tests/test_currency_rounding.py`, covering half-cent rounding in both directions, tiny and zero values, configurable precision, high-precision inputs, invalid negative `places`, mixed string/integer/Decimal inputs, and very large Decimal boundaries. `billing.currency.round_money` already uses Decimal quantization with `ROUND_HALF_UP`; no production change was required. Ruff passed and the six focused tests passed.

S3 migration copied all 184 objects from `s3://old-media-17` to `s3://archive-25`; inventory, verification, versioning cleanup, DNS changes, confirmation gates, and eventual destructive deletion remain pending. Customer exports are approved; Twilio retry/metrics guardrails were removed. Staging sampling requires Dana’s approval above 8%.

The multi-invoice allocation regression involving posting timestamps, ledger IDs, and `AllocationEngine` bucket ordering remains unresolved, as does authenticated dunning/collection pause functionality for selected overdue invoices and review of the legacy rounding fixture discrepancy.

Recently, inspection of `ledgerly/workers/billing_worker.py` found that `process_batch()` did not remove successfully charged events from `self.pending_events`. A change was made to pop each completed event after charging. However, `tests/workers/test_billing_worker.py` then produced 14 passes with one failure: `test_retry_retention` expected two retained events but found one, indicating the event is being removed too early. This worker change needs reconsideration or adjustment before proceeding.
summaries.structured:

Currency tests now cover mixed input types, rounding boundaries, precision, signs, and high-value Decimal handling; six focused tests pass, Ruff is clean, and the earlier full suite passed with 184 tests and 2 skipped.

S3 decommissioning remains at the verified dry-run stage: all 184 objects were present and none needed copying. Continue sequentially without reordering.

The principal planned application task remains an authenticated dunning pause endpoint. Ledger posting/order and multi-invoice credit issues remain unresolved.
